svg.title: Stakeholder coverage by influence and workflow knowledge
svg.desc: A two-by-two matrix with workflow knowledge on the horizontal axis and decision influence on the vertical axis. High influence and high knowledge: business owners, who define impact. High influence and low knowledge: the executive sponsor, who makes the decision. Low influence and high knowledge: front-line users, who explain the real work. Low influence and low knowledge: inform as needed.
